subsetPolicyRationale: `s.shooting.shooting@1` is this plugin's own self-contained camera-shot planning document — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (create-asset, delete-asset, rename-asset, change-asset-url, reorder-assets, drag-assets, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
